style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: he crosses the frame every beat till 6.85, bounding or tumbling side to side along the long desk; the toad hops away; camera arcs round him, new shot size each beat; he fills half the frame
character: palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, long thin fingers, huge amber eyes, loose tie; ONE fat toad banker, throat ballooning
props: ONE long oak desk; ONE blank schedule roll; ONE red stamp; ONE cloth pouch; ONE coin; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit bank office, open pane, sill flush with the desk end; toad's leather chair

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-6.85 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.85 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: paper, stamp thump, croak, air whoosh, coin clink

timeline.a: he whirls round the stamp handle like a pole, legs flung out flat; the toad gapes
he lets go, tumbling into a dash along the unspooling roll; the toad thumps the stamp behind him
he scurries along the roll, then leaps across the desk, head snapping 180° back; the toad slams the stamp at his heels
he lands running, scampering along the roll, ducking; the toad swats behind him
he bounds diagonally across the desk over the swinging stamp, then somersaults back over the roll; the toad hops to the far end, tongue lashing, missing
he sprints across the desk, yanking the pouch from his tie mid-stride; the toad hops away, stamp up
he races down the desk in long leaps, pouch whirling overhead; the toad flops backward, dropping the stamp
he bounds along the desk edge, head snapping 180° back mid-hop; the toad scoops up the roll, scuttling back
he crosses the last stretch in two bounds, pouch whirling like a sling; the toad backs onto the sill with the roll
he springs onto the sill, pouch fist up; the toad balloons her throat, blocking him
he jabs the pouch into her ballooned throat; air whooshes out, blowing her to the sill's edge, teetering
he yanks the roll's paper tail; the roll spins in her arms; she flails, flipping out through the open pane, the paper unspooling between them
he skids to the sill's edge, windmilling; the paper tail whips from his fingers out the pane
he hops down to the desk, head swinging 180° back to the empty chair; a coin drops from the pouch, clinking

must_appear: whirl 0.0, leap 1.4, pouch out mid-sprint 3.95, throat jab 7.5, toad out the pane 8.15, coin clink 9.4
negative_prompt: held mic, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.85, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, eye macro, pause inside a line, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, him running at the camera, far shot, still camera, landing pose, frontal stance while talking, him standing in place
